heard: An octopus has three beating hearts and bright blue copper-based blood. Stepping up from a single heart, this creature lacks bones entirely and can squeeze through gaps the size of a coin. Moving up the ladder of complexity, the entire animal possesses around 500 million total neurons. Climbing to the peak of biological weirdness, two-thirds of those cells live directly inside its eight arms. Because each arm contains more neurons than many small mammals, It can taste, touch, and move without the central brain. This decentralized mind lets veined octopuses walk their arms to collect discarded coconut shells for portable shelter. An octopus has three beating hearts and bright blue copper-based blood.
